title.narrative: Supporting Uganda's Strategy for Acceleration Towards Elimination of Malaria - Uganda (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Uganda, Malaria, Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development of the Republic of Uganda (MoFPED)This program has the following goals: By 2020, reduce annual malaria deaths from 2013 levels to near zero (from 29 per 100,000 to <1 per100,000). By 2020, reduce malaria morbidity to 30 cases per 1000 population (80% reduction from 2013 levels). By 2020, reduce the malaria parasite prevalence to less than 7% (>85% from the 2010 levels). The objectives of this program are: By 2017, achieve and sustain protection of at least 85% of the population at risk through recommended malaria prevention measures;. By 2018, achieve and sustain at least 90% of malaria cases in the public and private sectors and community level receive prompt treatment according to national guidelines. By 2017, at least 85% of the population practices correct malaria prevention and management measures. By 2016, the programme is able to manage and coordinate multi-sectoral malaria reduction efforts at all levels. By 2017, all health facilities and District Health Offices report routinely and timely on malaria programme performance. By 2017, all malaria epidemic prone districts have the capacity for epidemic preparedness and response
